name: Tei
source:
Belongs to Crobidoll's M-line. He was released as a premium limited edition doll causing him to be sold out immediately, but Eri managed to get him through an auction in used condition.

Tei is a great cook, and is even better at brewing coffee. With a gentle attitude towards everyone, he is the most popular guy at the academy. In his spare time, he works part-time at Café Banjul.

Hobbies: Reading, making coffee
Likes: Old books, aprons
Dislikes: Having a carefree attitude

[Edited From [url=http://nl.cheritz.com/en/game_info/characters]Nameless Official Site[/url]]
